queries_run: Eaton ETN analyst consensus price target 2026
Eaton ETN guidance raise 2026 Q2 earnings organic growth
Eaton ETN price target raised August 2026 analyst

findings.claim: Eaton Q2 2026 (reported 2026-07-30/31) revenue reached record $8.5B (+21% YoY, 14% organic), adjusted EPS $3.15 (Q2 record, beat guidance), segment margin 23.1%, both above company's prior guidance.
findings.source: Eaton press release "Eaton Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Results" (businesswire.com / eaton.com investor news)

findings.claim: Following Q2 beat, Eaton raised FY2026 guidance: organic growth guidance raised to 11%-13% (up 200bps at midpoint); adjusted EPS guidance raised to $13.40-$13.60 (midpoint $13.50). Electrical Americas segment growth guide raised 200bps to ~15% midpoint; Electrical Global raised 450bps to ~12% midpoint.
findings.source: Eaton press release "Eaton Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Results... Raises Organic Growth Guidance" (eaton.com/businesswire); corroborated by Fool.com Q2 2026 earnings call transcript

findings.claim: Sell-side analysts raised price targets meaningfully after the Q2 beat and guidance raise: Evercore ISI upgraded to Outperform and raised PT from $453 to $502 (2026-08-03); RBC Capital raised PT from $484 to $512 (2026-08-03); BMO Capital maintained Outperform and raised PT from $477 to $487 (2026-08-03); Morgan Stanley raised PT from $500 to $520 while maintaining Overweight (2026-08-28).
findings.source: Benzinga "Eaton Analysts Boost Their Forecasts After Strong Q2 Earnings"; TipRanks/TheFly price-target alerts

findings.claim: Broader consensus polls (post Q2, aggregated) show average 12-month price targets clustering in a wide $408-$492 range depending on source/window: S&P Global poll of 27 analysts averages $455.79 (Buy consensus); another poll of 11 analysts (targets issued in trailing 3 months) averages $492.43; a poll of 13 analysts averages $426.15. All cited averages sit above `numbers.price_at_dd` ($410.85 as of 2026-09-04), implying sell-side consensus is pricing in upside versus the current quote.
findings.source: Aggregated from stockanalysis.com/stocks/etn/forecast, WallStreetZen ETN stock forecast page, and Zacks ETN price-target page

capital_markets_pricing.note: 找不到單一標準化的『共識 vs guidance 落差』量化指標（如 consensus EPS 距 guidance 中值的差距%）；改以價格標的證據呈現：Q2 財報後公司上修 guidance，隨後多家券商上修目標價且多數目標價高於現價（`numbers.price_at_dd`=$410.85），顯示賣方尚未看到與公司 guidance 明顯背離的看法，方向一致偏多。目標價聚合來源（stockanalysis/WallStreetZen/Zacks/TipRanks）彼此口徑、樣本數與截止日不同，數字有分散，已如實列出區間而非單一「共識數字」。
